newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Brambles bids A$2/shr for Ausdoc.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Brambles bids A$2/shr for Ausdoc.

text.p: Diversified transport group Brambles Industries Ltd said it will offer A$2 a share cash for all the issued capital of document exchange group Ausdoc Ltd.
Brambles said the offer valued Ausdoc at A$111 million.
Brambles said its offer price represents a premium of 23 percent on Audoc's closing price of A$1.63 on Monday and 40 percent to Ausdoc's weighted average share price over the past six months.
It said the offer price represents a multiple of about 13 times Ausdoc's earnings before interest and tax for the year ended June 30.
On completion, Ausdoc's records management business would be combined with Brambles records management division and Brambles would continue the document exchange business.
Brambles said the offer is subject to certain conditions, including:
- Acceptance for at least 90 percent of Ausdoc's issued ordinary shares to enable Brambles to proceed to compulsory acquisition.
- The anti-monopoly Australian Competition and Consumer indicating it had no objection to the offer
- No material adverse change occurring in the business, financial or trading position or profitability or prospects of Ausdoc.
